headline: Last session: Nifty reclaims 25,000 as Sensex ends higher; markets closed today for NSE holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the gains in the previous session
Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 level following a recovery from the Muhurat dip
Modest gains were supported by a correction in global oil prices
PSU Bank stocks outperformed during a range-bound trading session
whatHappening: The NSE and BSE are closed today, November 10, for a scheduled trading holiday
L&T bagged a metro rail order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation valued between ₹1,000 - ₹2,500 crore
Sensex closed at its highest level in over eight months in the last session
Data Patterns recorded a 9% jump as the broader market indices ended in the green
summary: Indian markets are closed today for an NSE holiday, with trading set to resume on Wednesday. In the last session, the Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 mark and Sensex surpassed 81,000, driven by banking and pharma stocks. Notable corporate news included a major order win for L&T and a 9% surge in Data Patterns.
